question: Why is the essence of pervasion in nondifference from Śiva invoked at this point?
premises: The essence of pervasion in nondifference from Śiva is identified.
That essence is about to be shown.
An impending demonstration can justify present reference.
inference: It is invoked because the essence of pervasion in nondifference from Śiva is about to be demonstrated.
plain_english: Because the essence of pervasion in nondifference from Śiva is about to be shown.
